title: “Label from Somewhere”: Reflexive Annotating for Situated AI Alignment
benchmark_measurement: The study measured how annotators' self-identified positionality, which could optionally include religion as one of many identity facets, influenced their fairness judgments of text samples. It was not a direct benchmark of a model, but a probe to collect situated annotation data for potential AI alignment.
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to religion. Religion was included as one of many optional identity facets that annotators could use to explain their fairness judgments, but the analysis focused on the overall process and impact of reflexive annotating (e.g., intersectional reasoning, emotional exposure) rather than the influence of any single identity facet like religion.
